units: <cite ref="Yoma 75a:20">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>לשד</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 11:8">Num. XI, 8</cite>) <he>מה שד זה מתהפך וכ׳</he> as the demon changes into many colors (appearances), so did the manna change into many tastes.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:11">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 8:15">Ex. VIII, 15</cite>) <he>מיכן שאין השד וכ׳</he> from here we learn that the conjured demon cannot create anything smaller than a barley corn; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שֵׁדִים</he>, <he>שֵׁדִין</he>, <cite ref="U00252"><he>שֵׁי׳</he></cite>.

Lev. R. s. 22 (ref. to Lev. XVII, 7) ואין … אלא ש׳ this s’‘irim means demons; ואין ש׳ … שעירים and this shedim (Deut. XXXII, 17) means s’‘irim (ref. to Is. XIII, 21). Snh. l. c., v. לְהָטִים; a. fr.—Fem. שֵׁדָה, שֵׁי׳; pl. שֵׁדוֹת, שֵׁי׳.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> (expl. <he>שרה ושדות</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 2:8">Koh. II, 8</cite>) <he>שדים וש׳</he> male and female demons; Pesik. Haḥod., p. 45ᵇ before Solomon sinned, <he>היה רודה בשידה וש׳</he> he ruled over all sorts of demonesses.
